description.fun: Nidoran♀ and Nidoran♂ were the first Pokémon to have genders, a generation before every other species got them, which is why they're still two separate species today. Nidoran♀ is gentle and only uses the potent poison in its spines and small horn when threatened. Oddly, it's the only Pokémon that loses the ability to breed when it evolves.
description.guide: A small, blue, female-only Poison Pokémon with toxic spines on its back and a small horn. It is docile and uses its strong poison only when threatened. It is the female counterpart of Nidoran♂ and evolves into Nidorina.
description.tagline: Half of the first Pokémon pair to come in two genders

description.fun: Nidorina is a devoted mother: it chews food into a soft paste for its young, and folds its poison spikes away whenever it's with its family, feeding them or resting in its burrow. It gets nervous when separated from the group. Strangely, it can't lay Eggs itself, something settled in Japanese media before breeding was even a game mechanic.
description.guide: The middle stage of the female Nidoran line, a blue, female-only Poison Pokémon. It is gentle and caring, retracting its poison spikes when with its family, and prefers to avoid fights. It evolves into Nidoqueen with a Moon Stone.
description.tagline: A gentle mother who folds away her spikes at home

description.fun: Nidoqueen is at its strongest when defending its young: it seals the entrance to its burrow, and lets its children nestle between the spines on its back, which never release poison while they're there. Its armour-like scales shrug off almost any attack, and it's better at defending than attacking. It can't lay Eggs, though: it lost the ability when it evolved.
description.guide: The final stage of the female Nidoran line, a large Poison and Ground Pokémon covered in hard, armour-like scales. It is fiercely protective of its young, which it carries between the spines on its back. It evolves from Nidorina with a Moon Stone and is the counterpart of Nidoking.
description.tagline: An armoured mother whose back doubles as a nursery
